content_html: Using the GitHub mobile app as a free write-only blyg fragment (blygment?) creator. Issue to PR that makes the fragment and update the feed files. Triggers the existing build/deploy pipeline to get my thoughts into the blygosphere (blygodecahedron?). A new Hugo module, hugo-blyg, renders the human-readable stream using the site’s existing styles. Is this the much-vaunted composition I’ve heard so much about?
